title: Schwere Körperverletzung und versuchte räuberische Erpressung – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the neck at a bus stop in Neukölln early in the morning, and is in critical condition. Hours later, the 36-year-old suspect allegedly threatened a 32-year-old woman with a knife on a bus in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg and was arrested.
